answer: An hostile operator running 62 aliases as a result needs 142 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in dune, expire in yarrow, and saffron lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 13 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
